footnote_text: Reflects the Reporting Person's purchase on November 10, 2026 of 4,546 units from the Issuer, each unit consisting of one share of Common Stock and a warrant to purchase one share of Common Stock (the "PIPE Warrant"), at $5.50 per unit, in a private placement under a Securities Purchase Agreement. No separate consideration was paid for the PIPE Warrant. The closing occurred on November 10, 2026. The PIPE Warrant has an original issue date of November 10, 2026, is exercisable for cash at $10.00 per share, and expires on the fifth anniversary of its original issue date. || Share and underlying-share amounts reflect the 1-for-20 reverse stock split of the Issuer's common stock effective October 12, 2026. The amount beneficially owned following the reported transaction includes 7,833 shares held directly before the transaction, after giving effect to the reverse stock split.
